Hello 

How can I extract below quintiles
    c(0.01, 0.025, seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.05), 0.975, 0.99)
Can you pls suggest script?

thanks
Aynaz

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] quantile
parts:
The easy way out is to add it like this

r=inla(y ~ 1, data=data.frame(y=0), 
quantiles=c(0.01, 0.025, seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.05), 0.975, 0.99))

otherwise, you have to request it for every marginal, using
'inla.qmarginal'
